intro: "A Scroll from Mauren" is an Alliance errand carrying word between gnome ingenuity and human arcane craft. The inventive Gaxim Rustfizzle requires a specialized spell to remotely trigger his volatile NG-5 explosives, dispatching couriers to consult with mage Collin Mauren in the heart of Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Okay, now for the remote detonation part of my plan... Oh, I haven't explained that yet, have I?

Okay, so the short of it is this: with a little magic, I can make it so the explosives go off while you're not around. I'm putting together a device that'll allow you to push just one button and have the NG-5 explode when you're ready.
But I need a spell from a friend in Stormwind--Collin Mauren is his name. You can find him in the mage quarter there. He's human, so he shouldn't be hard to miss.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now, this spell you need; one that will allow you detonate explosives from a distance... Hmmm.
